verdict.rationale: Proton Pass's own CLI documents deleting vaults and individual items, so users can directly remove their stored data. Nothing in the evidence covers retention controls: no retention periods, auto-deletion, account or server-side data erasure guarantees, or deletion of telemetry or logs. Export is documented, but that is portability, not deletion. missing for 10: configurable retention policies, account-level or server-side data deletion documentation, deletion guarantees for backups and telemetry, independent or hands-on corroboration.
